basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old airsoft aficionado based in Colorado. I've been into airsoft for over a decade, and I'm always on the lookout for rare and unique replicas, particularly those based on real-world firearms like the FN FNC. By day, I work as a mechanical engineer, which gives me a unique appreciation for the design and mechanics of airsoft guns. I'm married and have two kids, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after the kids are in bed. I love discussing airsoft strategies and equipment, but I also enjoy unwinding with some gaming or lighthearted content.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of airsoft mechanics and equipment, largely due to my engineering background and years of hands-on experience. I often share insights and advice in the airsoft community, drawing from both my professional knowledge and personal hobbyist experience.
